identity.documentTitle: 令和6年度歳出概算要求書（一般会計）

sourceSafeProfile.description: (A) Features obtainable without running pdfjs-baseline, pymupdf-baseline, or docling. Legitimate strategy-selection input for an unseen document, per the architecture report's Document Profile split.

features.note: Plain fetch() failed first (HTTP 202, x-amzn-waf-action: challenge, AWS WAF Bot Control JS challenge); a real headless-Chromium session (Playwright 1.63.0) visiting the landing page first was required to acquire the binary.
From pdfinfo (poppler), which performs no text/layout reconstruction and is not one of the three compared engines, per the case-002 selection protocol's tooling rule.
pdfinfo confirms basic PDF validity, but no explicit text-layer-presence check independent of running an engine is recorded.
E3 of the selection protocol (multi-line wrap) confirmed by direct visual inspection (pdftoppm render, 300dpi) before Ground Truth was created.
E4 of the selection protocol confirmed the standard three-column relationship in its native layout before Ground Truth was created.

'(単位: 千円)' observed directly beneath the table title, confirmed at selection time (E5) and re-verified independently during Ground Truth creation via a dedicated high-resolution crop. A genuine structural difference from case-001's target page, observed before any engine was run.

Six neighboring rows on the same page visibly carry a △ (decrease) glyph, confirming the page uses this convention generally. This does NOT reveal the target row's own delta sign (that is a Ground Truth field, deltaRaw, intentionally not duplicated here) — it only records that the convention exists on the page, observable independent of the target row itself.
Request numbers on this page use circled numerals (e.g. ①), unlike case-001's plain digit convention — observed and normalized during Ground Truth creation, not engine-derived.

engineDerivedProfile.description: (B) Features only knowable after running at least one analysis engine. Never usable as strategy-selection input for this same document (would be circular); recorded here only as a logged outcome for future cross-case comparison, per the architecture report's leakage-avoidance rule.

features.note: All three engines reconstructed the target line/cells; the failures are at the structure-recovery/normalization stage, not raw extraction.

This characterization ('（要求要旨）' follows the amount triple on the SAME reconstructed line, unlike case-001 where the equivalent annotation only ever appeared on continuation lines) was established via the flat-text engines' raw line-reconstruction output during the first frozen run, not via independent pre-engine visual layout inspection. It is plausibly a source-observable layout fact (adjacent-column annotation in the same table row), but this repository did not actually record it that way — flagged as an open Document Profile A/B boundary ambiguity in this backfill's architecture-feedback notes.
common.mjs's trailing-anchored regex requires the amount triple to be the literal end of the line; broke on both pdfjs-baseline and pymupdf-baseline for this row.

pdfjs-dist inserted a literal space between every CJK character in header-style rows on this page; PyMuPDF's sort=True reconstruction did not. This flipped item_name_present_among_candidates between the two flat-text engines, exposing that common.mjs lacks an equivalent of normalize-docling.mjs's closeCjkWrapSpaces.
Coarser and misaligned relative to case-001's 21x14 grid for the same benchmark; 1 of 322 cells dropped.

Docling reported itemCandidateCount: 1 (implying no ambiguity) while actually matching an unrelated, deeper-hierarchy row ('001 人件費...'), because this page's expense code and its label landed in different, unpaired grid cells. A more concerning failure mode than the flat-text baselines' honest nulls.

Both flat-text engines found the same 4 item-code-shaped candidates (010, 010, 001, 001) with no disambiguation — mirroring case-001's finding, but discovered here via engine output, not via independent pre-engine visual inspection (the selection protocol explicitly excluded this as a selection criterion, to be observed afterward).

This case's own Ground Truth (deltaRaw with no glyph) is what first exposed that delta_glyph_observed_and_associated hardcoded 'expected: contains △' regardless of Ground Truth — a benchmark-methodology defect, not an extraction/normalization one. See research-history.jsonl for the correction event.
Current scores under the corrected evaluator (post-519ce28), up by exactly +1 per engine from the first frozen run's 2/11, 3/11, 2/11 (see research-history.jsonl for both, preserved separately).
